sn54.8:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: ānāpānasatisamādhi bhikkhave, bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.8:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvito ca bhikkhave, ānāpānasatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso:
sn54.8:2.1: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā
sn54.8:2.5: evaṃ bhāvito kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.8:3.1: ahampi sudaṃ bhikkhave, pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi.
sn54.8:3.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave, iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharato neva kāyo kilami. na cakkhūni,
sn54.8:3.3: anupādāya ca me āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
sn54.8:4.2: “neva me kāyo kilameyya na cakkhūni, anupādāya ca me āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā”ti,
sn54.8:10.2: “appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti”
sn54.8:11.2: “vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti”
sn54.8:12.2: “vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti”
sn54.8:13.2: “pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca vihareyyaṃ sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeyyaṃ yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti”
sn54.8:14.2: “sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti”
sn54.8:15.2: sabbaso rūpa saññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃamanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti,
sn54.8:16.2: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:17.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:18.2: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:20.1: evaṃ bhāvite kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasatisamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate sukhañce vedanaṃ vedeti sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn54.8:20.2: dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedeti sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn54.8:20.3: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedeti, sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti. so
sn54.8:21.1: sukhañce vedanaṃ vediti, visaṃyutto naṃ vediyati.
sn54.8:21.2: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaṃyutto naṃ vediyati.
sn54.8:21.3: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaṃyutto naṃ vediyati.
sn54.8:21.4: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.
sn54.8:21.5: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn54.8:22.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya,
sn54.8:22.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya,
sn54.8:22.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.
sn54.8:22.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānātīti.
